scope: Resume the exact attended H10 run02 only after its one durable proved arm result, without re-arming, then bind and dispatch at most one reboot before normal observation and finalization.
reviewed_properties: The live effect entry accepts only the exact predecessor closure and exact attended three-record prefix, before path or device access.
The stored arm receipt tolerates native serial wrapper lines but requires the exact ordered qualifying, source-SHA, qualified, and armed tag set; every other same-family tag line is rejected.
The resume path contains no arm token or arm dispatch and revalidates the stored arm intent hash, exact post-arm 1/0 state, same source metadata, exact receipt, and H10 resident health.
The successor closure is written into the durable reboot intent, which precedes the sole reboot dispatch.
Exact auto-handoff state and ModemManager guard health are rechecked before reboot intent and immediately before dispatch; every proved pre-dispatch or exact non-dispatch failure releases the guard.

Historical-closure reconcile remains read-only, and exact run02 successor prefixes five through nine remain eligible for no-replay tail recovery while unrelated historical closure handling stays narrow.
Journal arm, reboot, and cleanup counts require exact integers and reject booleans.
Normal status framing is accepted only with one exact A90AUTO_STATUS tag-family line; malformed, duplicate, suffixed, or contradictory lines fail closed.
No path can replay the arm or reboot after an uncertain dispatch.

resolved_before_final_review: Added historical-closure support to read-only reconcile.
Opened historical tail recovery for only the exact run02 predecessor and prefixes five through nine.
Bound the live resume entry to the exact predecessor closure before path or device contact.
Added successor execution closure to the durable reboot intent.
Added guard and status rechecks at both reboot boundaries plus release on every exact pre-dispatch or non-dispatch failure.
Rejected malformed same-family auto-handoff status lines.
Rejected boolean values in every journal dispatch-count field.

review_lifetime: Valid only for the exact predecessor and successor closures above while the incident journal prefix, installed H10 identity, recovery assumptions, and hazard assumptions remain unchanged.
